summary: Router 0.23.0 adds a guided first configuration (ADR-0067). New router/config.minimal.yaml: one role and model, client_auth enforce and locked, control and API TLS, no cloud, MQTT or decision engine; its placeholders (control users empty, the example token sha256('changeme')) load but are reported by the posture check. New skirnir_router/setup_init.py behind `router.py --init <dir>`: refuses if <dir>/config.yaml exists, the template lacks an expected line, the password is shorter than 12 characters or differs from its repetition on a terminal, a user or client name is not plain, or --public-url is not https; reads the password with getpass on a terminal or one line from stdin otherwise; stores only auth.hash_password(password) and sha256 of a secrets.token_urlsafe(32) client token; writes the file with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and mode 0600; loads it like --check; prints the posture report and the token once; ends with INIT: written or INIT: refused. app.cli gains --help, --hash without argument (getpass, no shell history), --init, and refuses unknown options instead of loading them as a configuration path. posture.py gains client_example_token (high; sha256 of a fixed list of placeholder tokens, names only in output), control_without_tls (high; control_listen not loopback and no control_tls) and control_on_network (info). The publication guard (test/check_public_changes.py) now also accepts the unspecified address 0.0.0.0 (listen on all interfaces), like loopback; private and other non-example addresses are still reported (selftest_memory covers both).

findings.evidence: The full example configuration gave four clients the token 'changeme' with every role, and the posture report did not flag it.
findings.resolution: Guided --init with generated secrets; posture flags well-known example tokens.

findings.evidence: A control port on a network address without control_tls carried Basic Auth and the agent tunnel in plaintext with only a log warning; router.py --hash took the password on the command line.
findings.resolution: Posture reports control_without_tls (high); --hash and --init ask without echo.

tests.evidence: 4 tests OK: valid owner-only configuration (0600 on Linux), hash verifies, token only as sha256 and shown once, no high/medium finding; refusals leave files untouched; template loads with its placeholders reported; --help and unknown option.
6 tests OK including client_example_token, control_on_network and control_without_tls.

tests.command: All python test/... commands of ci.yml and security.yml (WSL); check_adr_index; selftest_english_names; check_control_flow; ruff check .
tests.evidence: No failures; ADR index ok: 67 ADRs; ALLE OK; control flow ok; All checks passed.

limitations: The qwen3:8b catalogue values in config.minimal.yaml are starting estimates, not measurements.
The example-token list is a fixed set of common placeholders, not a strength check of real tokens.
